title: 5 Day Budget Namibia Camping Safari: Sossusvlei and Swakopmund
rank_math_title: Budget Namibia Safari: 5-Day Sossusvlei Camping Trip
rank_math_desc: Budget Namibia safari for 5 days: camping at Sesriem for the Sossusvlei dunes and Deadvlei, then two nights in Swakopmund on the coast.
post_content: This budget Namibia safari takes you to the country's most famous sights for a fraction of the lodge price.
overview:
This budget Namibia safari takes you to the country's most famous sights for a fraction of the lodge price. Camp two nights at Sesriem campsite right by the park gate, so you are first onto the Sossusvlei dunes at sunrise, then continue through the desert to the coast for two nights at Desert Sky Backpackers in Swakopmund, where you can add sandboarding, kayaking or a dolphin cruise. It suits backpackers, students and photographers.

Price: from USD 640 per adult sharing (low season estimate). Contact us for your exact dates.
highlights: Two nights camping at Sesriem, next to the park gate
Sunrise on the dunes and a walk into Deadvlei
Two nights in Swakopmund on the Atlantic coast

faq.q: How much does this budget Namibia safari cost?
faq.a: It starts from USD 640 per adult with a shared vehicle, based on current rates. We confirm the price for your dates when you enquire.

faq.q: Do I need my own camping gear?
faq.a: No. Tents, mattresses and cooking equipment are provided; bring or hire a sleeping bag.

faq.q: When is the best time to go?
faq.a: April to October has clear, dry days; desert nights can be cold from June to August.

featured_image.alt: The Deadvlei clay pan surrounded by tall red dunes in Namib-Naukluft National Park

itinerary.label: Day 1
itinerary.title: Windhoek to Sesriem
itinerary.content: Collection in Windhoek and drive south-west to the Namib Desert. Dinner and overnight at Sesriem Campsite.

itinerary.label: Day 2
itinerary.title: Sossusvlei and Deadvlei
itinerary.content: Enter the park at first light to climb the dunes and walk into Deadvlei, then visit Sesriem Canyon. Dinner and overnight at Sesriem Campsite.

itinerary.label: Day 3
itinerary.title: Sesriem to Swakopmund
itinerary.content: Drive through the Gaub and Kuiseb passes and Walvis Bay to Swakopmund. Overnight at Desert Sky Backpackers.

itinerary.label: Day 4
itinerary.title: Swakopmund
itinerary.content: Free day for optional activities. Overnight at Desert Sky Backpackers.

includes: Shared safari vehicle with English-speaking guide
Camping equipment, cook and meals while camping
Sossusvlei park entry and conservation fees (N$280 per adult per day from April 2026)
excludes: International flights, visa and travel insurance
Tips for guides and camp staff
Drinks unless stated, laundry and personal expenses
Optional activities not listed in the itinerary
